test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

Some papers are tables.

Some ropes are tables.

All tables are clothes.

**Conclusions**:

(I) Some papers are clothes.

(II) Some ropes are clothes.

(III) No cloth is a rope.

(IV) No paper is a rope.

options.text: Only conclusions III and IV follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bca3eddf722b70c25940e7d29b509ff3cb9a410b81dfc166b11f807d17905862.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some papers are clothes → True (As Some papers are tables and All tables are clothes so, Some papers are clothes is true)

(II) Some ropes are clothes → True (As Some ropes are tables and All tables are clothes so, Some ropes are clothes is true)

(III) No cloth is a rope → False (As Some ropes are tables and All tables are clothes so, No cloth is a rope is false)

(IV) No paper is a rope → False (it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I, II follow".**
